title: TIMBER WOLF STRAIGHT 1.2OZ LONG CUT
description:
TIMBER WOLF STRAIGHT 1.2OZ LONG CUT

TIMBER WOLF STRAIGHT 1.2OZ LONG CUT has a taste of tobacco, spices, sweetness. This is a loose cut product that consists of small strands of tobacco. Cans of snuff contain 30 to 40 grams of tobacco; chewing tobacco is supplied in 70- to 80-gram pouches with bricks or square plugs. One pouch of tobacco or a half can of snuff might be given as examples of amounts utilized over a ten-year period. Tobacco products can be sniffed, chewed, or smoked. Products made from smoked tobacco include bidis, kreteks, cigarettes, and cigars. In addition, some individuals use a pipe or hookah (water pipe) to smoke loose tobacco. Chewing tobacco, snuff, dip, and snus are examples of goods made from chewing tobacco; snuff can also be smelled.
